name: Station Nav
description: A table of contents drawn as a railway line, with a station for each section and a small train that runs down the line as the page scrolls.

props.name: items
props.type: { id: string; label: ReactNode; detail?: ReactNode }[]
props.description: One station per section. `id` is the id of the section element on the page; `detail` is a short time-like note under the name, such as a time or a reading length.

props.name: container
props.description: A scrolling element to follow instead of the window. Sections are looked up inside it.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour of the travelled line and of passed and current stations.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the nav element. Below 9rem wide the names are hidden and only the line shows. Other nav props are passed through.
